fixed_rules.timing: Exploratory sensitivity added after the main rank-SASA analysis showed a 14.00 A2 mean physical SASA difference. Main rank-SASA results are retained unchanged. User/root explicitly authorized symmetric absolute-area checks.
fixed_rules.eligibility: Same original record and AA; at least 4 quality-qualified common positions per record/AA, every unordered i<j pair. All positions in the source already satisfy finite SASA, complete input sidechain/chi atoms, and standard-residue checks.
fixed_rules.calipers: Absolute complex sidechain SASA difference <=10 A2 central sensitivity, <=5 and <=20 A2 additional sensitivities, each combined with absolute truth RMSF difference <=0.10 A for Hchi target, or absolute truth Hchi difference <=0.10 nats for RMSF target.
fixed_rules.pair_scopes: all_within_record and same_chain_only; same-chain subset retains the record/AA eligibility and target-rank definition, with pair chain identifiers required equal. A record is an assembly, not necessarily one protein chain.
fixed_rules.target_strata: all_close plus separated_target_p50 (target average-rank/n percentile difference >=0.50 within the original quality-qualified record/AA group). No prediction controls inclusion.
fixed_rules.aggregation_uncertainty: Same pair -> AA -> record equal-weight aggregation and 10000 whole-family-cluster percentile bootstrap as the original protocol; undefined records are retained. Family-equal and leave-largest-family-out summaries are descriptive sensitivities.
fixed_rules.new_claim_limit: Robustness of complementary outputs, not evidence of causal effects, partner-induced changes, full thermodynamic entropy, or family-held-out generalization.
